description: Request a login, one-time code seed or other credential for a task without ever seeing it. Returns an entry_url for the user to open and seal the value in their browser (the confirmation code is never returned to the agent; the user's own session needs none); the value never passes through chat or this tool. When status becomes provided, fill it with a fill_secret action carrying credential_request and field. reuse is once, task or standing; the domain must be within the task's allowed domains.

ask_each_time.description: Require user confirmation per later task; default false

domain.description: Site the credential is for, e.g. example.com

reason.description: Why it is needed, shown to the user

reuse.description: How long the credential stays usable; default once

name: alterlab_request_credential
title: Request Credential
